## Description

ELIGIBILITY_CHECK per coverage: live check via adapter where available (UAE platforms; India TPA where an API exists) else manual result entry with reference; shows eligible/not eligible, co-pay and validity; estimate shown to the patient. Medvya does not decide eligibility.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Eligibility results store source, reference, timestamp and the user who checked.
- [ ] **AC2.** Co-pay estimate appears in billing and on the UAE portal insurance card.
- [ ] **AC3.** Adapter failures fall back to manual entry without blocking care.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
